title: Sublaminations and superlaminations — Question 6.3
exact_target: Determine when a genuine lamination can be enlarged so that every complementary region is an ideal polygon bundle, and how hyperbolicity affects this.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10300013 (AMR-102-0013). CC BY 4.0.
